decisions.decision: AlignFull reads file via git show HEAD:path (repo-root-relative) before falling back to git show :path and then os.ReadFile
decisions.rationale: os.ReadFile with relative path fails when running alturd from a subdirectory; git show HEAD:path works from any CWD

decisions.decision: scrollToFirstHunk() called after file cycle, tree navigate, and v-toggle but NOT after window resize
decisions.rationale: Prevents viewport jumping on resize while ensuring first change is visible on file load/mode switch

decisions.decision: HunkOnly mode keeps existing behavior (hunk context lines shown); FullFile mode is the true-full-file view
decisions.rationale: Matches DIFF-05/DIFF-06 spec: full-file = entire file; hunk-only = diff hunks with 3-line context
